name: manual_39c06b
claim: For direct AntiGravity reviews, verify nonempty substantive output as well as exit status. Headless command denial may return exit zero; disable-slash-commands can neutralize mode plan. A source-supplied no-tool review is a useful graceful degradation, but never counts as independent shell, test, artifact, or live-state verification.

decisions.notes: Four initial tool-enabled attempts returned empty output and permission-denial logs; four fresh source-supplied attempts returned review text. Use attached --print=VALUE, bounded runtime and separate source-pinned worktrees. Preserve frozen branches and the reviewer/maker distinction. Findings still require parent verification.
